origin.description: Runge-Kutta-Fehlberg pair of orders 5 and 4. The fifth-order value is kept, and the fourth-order difference sets the next step.
origin.usage: rkf54(f, a, b, y0, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5, control = list(), ...)

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Tolerance used to accept a step and to grow it.

arguments.name: control
arguments.text: Optional hmin, hmax, and jmax. A unique prefix is accepted.
